correctness.rationale: Every qubit binary POVM observable is O=aI+t n.sigma with |a|+t<=1; the correlations are a+t n.r. For each preparation, the two measured Bloch-vector projections can be preserved by a pure Bloch representative, including the third with only one relevant projection. The angular function h(theta)=asin(a+t cos(theta)) satisfies -1<=hprime<=0 because t^2(1-c^2)<=1-(a+tc)^2 follows from |a|+t<=1, including endpoints by continuity. Maximal spherical distance between two polar angles is min(theta1+theta2,2pi-theta1-theta2); 1-Lipschitz monotonicity pushes the three-point estimate to theta1+theta2=pi. The scalar bound asin(a+tc)+asin(a-tc) <= pi/2+asin(a-t) follows for a>=0 by monotonicity in c and c=1, and for a<=0 by bounding the left side by 2asin(a)<=0. Applied with the second observable geodesic-Lipschitz and reversed observables, this yields |Q|<=3pi/2. Explicit projective measurements give correlations (1/sqrt2,1/sqrt2,1/sqrt2,-1/sqrt2,-1), reaching equality. Independent fresh random 20,000 scalar triples passed and sharpness checked numerically; this sampling is not the universal proof.
